decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the established portfolio and given its own product page, management would likely continue backing it because recent investments and public commitment make weak early results easy to treat as temporary launch effects.

Despite being more distant from the established offer, it was newly launched in 2024 and presented on its own page, so under escalation of commitment management would tend to justify the investment and allow more time before admitting the move was unsuccessful.

This product fits the firm's core pharmaceutical capabilities, supports its stated direction toward improved formulations, and has visible market presentation, which together make management likely to persist with it after only a short time on the market.

Because it builds on the firm's self-care and pharmacy-oriented offer and supports the strategic aim of differentiated health products, management would likely retain it and explain any limited early traction as normal market-building rather than grounds for withdrawal.
